'''Voorpaks''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] but still quite smart [[Species/Legends|species]] of puffy-looking creatures that were native to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

[[File:Voorpak1-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A voorpak colony]]

Diminutive [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]], voorpaks were much beloved by many [[Gender/Legends|ladies]] of Naboo. Despite their beguiling appearance, they were brave and loyal, and could be quite fierce when provoked or frightened. They possessed a full set of needle-sharp teeth, as well as large eyes well suited for nocturnal vision. In the wild, they lived in small colonies that dotted the craggy rock outcroppings of the hill country. They were most active during twilight hours, prowling for [[Water/Legends|water]] and prey.

Due to the voorpaks' light weight, their bone structure could support eight legs without significant difficulty. Voorpaks emitted a soothing, cooing purr, which rose to a hum when alarmed. They rested with legs tucked under body to conserve heat. Their [[Hair/Legends|fur]] was extremely soft. Voorpaks came into heat once a year. They produced litters of three to five pups. For centuries, noblewomen and the aristocracy of Naboo kept voorpaks as mascots and pets, carrying them about in their pockets and sleeves. They also made great hand warmers in the winter. Their pleasant scent was also a much-admired quality.

{{Creature-stub}}

A [[Unidentified New Republic Quermian diplomat|Quermian]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had a pet voorpak.

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
During [[Roan Novachez]]'s second year at the [[Jedi academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the students were given the opportunity to care for a pet voorpak named [[Voorpee]], on loan from the [[Naboo Zoo]]. The voorpak returned in the next school year. This particular voorpak enjoyed eating [[Insect/Legends|insects]].<ref name="return">''[[Jedi Academy: Return of the Padawan]]''</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}
